about: TAG-Bench-style questions over the bundled movies database. Categories follow the TAG paper (match, comparison, ranking, aggregation); needs = none (plain SQL), knowledge (world knowledge) or reasoning (semantic judgment over text).

items.question: Which drama set in a European capital has the highest rating?

plan.sql: SELECT title, setting_city, rating FROM movies WHERE genre = :genre ORDER BY rating DESC

ops.criterion: the city is the capital of a European country

items.evidence: SELECT id FROM movies WHERE genre = 'Drama'

items.question: Which comedies are about time travel?

plan.sql: SELECT title, plot FROM movies WHERE genre = :genre ORDER BY title

items.evidence: SELECT id FROM movies WHERE genre = 'Comedy'

items.question: How many reviews of The Glass Orchard are sarcastic?

plan.sql: SELECT r.id, r.text FROM reviews AS r JOIN movies AS m ON m.id = r.movie_id WHERE m.title = :title

items.evidence: SELECT id FROM reviews WHERE movie_id = 1

items.question: Which movie has the highest box office gross?

plan.sql: SELECT title FROM movies ORDER BY gross_musd DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: Which grossed more, Salt Lines or The Last Tram?

plan.sql: SELECT title, gross_musd FROM movies WHERE title IN (:a, :b) ORDER BY gross_musd DESC LIMIT 1

items.evidence: SELECT id FROM movies WHERE id IN (3, 6)

items.question: Which earned more at the box office in total: movies set in South America or movies set in Africa?

plan.sql: SELECT title, setting_city, gross_musd FROM movies

ops.criterion: the city is in South America or in Africa

ops.instruction: name the continent the city is in

items.evidence: SELECT id FROM movies WHERE setting_city IN ('Valparaíso', 'Santiago', 'Rio de Janeiro', 'Bogotá', 'Lima', 'Buenos Aires', 'Lagos', 'Nairobi', 'Cairo', 'Marrakesh')

items.question: Who directed more movies set in coastal cities, Ines Varga or Tomas Reyes?

plan.sql: SELECT director, title, setting_city FROM movies WHERE director IN (:a, :b)

ops.criterion: the city lies on a sea or ocean coast

items.evidence: SELECT id FROM movies WHERE director IN ('Ines Varga', 'Tomas Reyes')

items.question: Which three reviewers wrote the most enthusiastic reviews of Paper Moons?

plan.sql: SELECT r.reviewer, r.text FROM reviews AS r JOIN movies AS m ON m.id = r.movie_id WHERE m.title = :title

items.evidence: SELECT id FROM reviews WHERE movie_id = 26

items.question: Of the five highest-grossing movies, which has the most uplifting plot?

plan.sql: SELECT title, plot FROM movies ORDER BY gross_musd DESC LIMIT 5

ops.criterion: how uplifting and heart-warming the plot is

items.evidence: SELECT id FROM movies ORDER BY gross_musd DESC LIMIT 5

items.question: Which two movies set in Asian megacities have the highest ratings?

plan.sql: SELECT title, setting_city, rating FROM movies ORDER BY rating DESC

ops.criterion: the city is an Asian megacity with more than ten million people in its metropolitan area

items.evidence: SELECT id FROM movies WHERE setting_city IN ('Tokyo', 'Mumbai', 'Seoul', 'Bangkok')

items.question: What is the average star rating of the sarcastic reviews?

plan.sql: SELECT id, stars, text FROM reviews

items.evidence: SELECT id FROM reviews WHERE id IN (2, 4, 13, 16, 18, 23)

items.question: Summarize what reviewers say about The Glass Orchard.

plan.sql: SELECT r.reviewer, r.stars, r.text FROM reviews AS r JOIN movies AS m ON m.id = r.movie_id WHERE m.title = :title

items.answer: Most reviewers call it a tender, slow film about grief and praise the neighbours and the final orchard scene; two sarcastic reviews find it dull and mock the sound mix.
items.evidence: SELECT id FROM reviews WHERE movie_id = 1

items.question: What is the average rating of the sci-fi movies?

plan.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM movies WHERE genre = :genre

items.evidence: SELECT id FROM movies WHERE genre = 'Sci-Fi'
